Resp  Through: Mr. Anupam Sharma, SPP for CBI  and Mr. Vashisht Rao, Advocate  CORAM:
 HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE SWARANA KANTA SHARMA  ORDER % 07.08.2025 CRL.M.A. 23041/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.C. 5345/2025 & CRL.M.A. 23040/2025 3. By way of the present petition, the petitioners are seeking following prayer:
"A. Quash chargesheet dated 30.10.2009 and all consequent proceedings pending in CC CBI NO 17/2021 arising out of FIR bearing no. RC BD1/2008/E/0008 under Sections 120B r/w 420/467/468/471 IPC consequent to which CC NO. CBI/17/2021 titled CBI vs. Ankur Aggarwal is pending before of the Ld. ACJM-06, Rouse Avenue District Court, New Delhi."
4. Issue notice to remaining respondent through all permissible modes, including electronically,
returnable on the next date of hearing.

5. Let the Trial Court Record, in digitized form, be called for, at least This is a digitally signed order.
